description: Defines a Flutter widget 'Board' representing a 3x3 game board for Tic Tac Toe, which displays cells and highlights winning lines.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that renders a 3x3 grid of cells for the Tic Tac Toe game, with support for highlighting a winning line and disabling input when locked.

methods.name: _isWinningIndex
methods.description: Checks if a given cell index is part of the winning line.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the game board, including layout, styling, and cell generation.
